description: Land Title Settlement Department - Nawagamuwa, Aththanagalla D/S Division, Gampaha District
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act, No. 21 of 1998. It contains declarations of determination by the Commissioner of Title Settlement regarding specific land parcels, including detailed information about land ownership, parcel numbers, extents, and property details. The content appears in "PART III - LANDS" of the gazette and focuses on land adjudication and title settlement processes, which falls squarely under the Land Gazettes category (Type 4) for land and property-related matters.
